brands.ja: HG［ハイグレード］／プレバンガンプラ

description.ja: ガ ン ダ ム Ｍ ｋ - ＩＩＩ 、 Ｈ Ｇ シ リ ー ズ で 参 戦 ！ ―
description.en: Gundam Mk-III, joining the HG series! ―

description.ja: 『機動戦士Ｚガンダム』ＭＳＶより、エゥーゴの次世代ＭＳ試案として開発されたガンダムＭｋ-ＩＩＩをＨＧシリーズで商品化。
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Z Gundam" MSV, Gundam Mk-III, which was developed as AEG's next-generation MS prototype, is commercialized in the HG series.

description.ja: 特徴的な全身の各部位を新規造形で再現し、印象的な機体色を成形色で表現。専用シールド等豊富な武装類が付属。
description.en: Each characteristic body part is reproduced with new modeling, and the impressive body color is expressed with molding color. Comes with a variety of weapons such as special Seals.

description.ja: ●　ガンダム Mk-IIIの機体形状を新規造形で徹底再現
description.en: - Thoroughly reproduce the Gundam Mk-III's fuselage shape with new modeling

description.ja: 特徴的な頭部をはじめ、胸部、肩部、脚部、バックパック等、ガンダムＭｋ-ＩＩＩを構成する機体形状を新規造形パーツを交えて再現。
description.en: The shape of the Gundam Mk-III, including its characteristic head, chest, shoulders, legs, backpack, etc., is reproduced with new modeling parts.

description.ja: 頭部
description.en: head

description.ja: シャープな形状が特徴的な頭部を新規再現。
description.en: A new reproduction of the head with a distinctive sharp shape.

description.ja: 胸部・肩部・脚部
description.en: Chest/shoulders/legs

description.ja: 特徴的な胸部胴体及び肩部、脚部アーマーを再現。
description.en: Reproduce the characteristic chest torso, shoulders, and leg armor.

description.ja: コックピット周辺の形状や排気ダクト等のディテールを細やかに再現し、肩部、脚部側面の赤い外装はパーツごとに色分け再現。
description.en: Details such as the shape around the cockpit and exhaust ducts are reproduced in detail, and the red exterior on the sides of the shoulders and legs are color-coded for each part.

description.ja: バック・パック
description.en: back pack

description.ja: ２連装ビーム・キャノンを搭載したバックパックを再現。
description.en: Reproduces a backpack equipped with dual beam cannons.

description.ja: キャノン砲は上下角度調整が可能。印象的なバインダーは上下可動と基部の回転軸によりフレキシブルに可動。
description.en: The cannon can be adjusted up and down. The impressive binder can be moved flexibly by moving up and down and by the rotating shaft at the base.

description.ja: ●　ビーム・ライフル、専用シールド等、豊富な武装が付属！
description.en: ● Comes with a wide range of armaments such as beam rifles and special Seals!

description.ja: 印象的な専用シールドを新規造形で再現。ビーム・サーベルの着脱や予備エネルギーパックを装着可能。
description.en: Reproduce the impressive special seal with new modeling. Beam saber and spare energy pack can be attached and detached.

description.ja: さらに、２種類のビーム・ライフルや大型のビーム・サーベル用エフェクトが付属。
description.en: Additionally, two types of beam rifles and large beam saber effects are included.

description.ja: ビーム・サーベル（ビーム・キャノン）
description.en: Beam saber (beam cannon)

description.ja: ２連装ビーム・キャノンの砲身を取り外し、大型のビーム・サーベルを再現可能！
description.en: By removing the barrel of the double beam cannon, you can recreate a large beam saber!

description.ja: 専用の握り手パーツが左右で付属
description.en: Dedicated grip parts are included for left and right.

description.ja: 専用シールド
description.en: Dedicated Seal

description.ja: ガンダムＭｋ-ＩＩＩが装備する特徴的なシールドを新規再現。
description.en: A new reproduction of the characteristic Seal equipped by Gundam Mk-III.

description.ja: シールドに取り付けられたビーム・サーベルは着脱可能。シールド裏面にはエネルギーパックが装着可能。
description.en: The beam saber attached to Seal is removable. An energy pack can be attached to the back of the seal.

description.ja: 付属武装：ビーム・ライフル（２種）/ ビーム・サーベル（ビーム・キャノン）/ シールド / ビーム・サーベル
description.en: Attached weapons: Beam rifle (2 types) / Beam saber (Beam cannon) / Seal / Beam saber
